journey.name: TL-02 A long title does not break the row layout
journey.description:
Covers FR-01's last clause and backlog task TB-303. The fourth seed row is deliberately long and SeedData.kt:9-11 forbids shortening it: it exists to stress this layout. The title is capped at two lines with an ellipsis (TaskRow.kt:77-83), and the row's controls must survive that.
A failure here looks like a clipped delete icon, a checkbox pushed off the left edge, or a title that pushes the priority label out of the row.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0
